title: Keralam government gets legal opinion to proceed against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar in abetment to suicide case
content: T. Asaf Ali, Director General of Prosecution, gives legal advice that there is no legal bar in proceeding against Gyanesh Kumar. The case pertains to the reported suicide of Malaysian Lee See Been, a former chief project officer of Kerala State Transport Project for reconstruction of M.C. Road

title: Protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar: AISA president Neha released at Narela Industrial Area police station
content: A post from the AISA President's X account claimed that she did not have her bag and phone with her, and lawyers were being sent to the station

title: Tusker Pallatt Brahmadathan dies after lightning strike near Erattupetta in Keralam’s Kottayam
content: Known for his calm and gentle nature, Brahmadathan was fondly referred to by elephant lovers as Gaja Kausthubham Pallatt Brahmadathan

title: Thiruvananthapuram Corporation’s BJP councillor R. Sreelekha does a U-turn after resignation bid
content: Ms. Sreelekha reportedly mentioned in her ward’s WhatsApp group that she had informed the Mayor through a letter about resigning as a councillor for personal reasons. On Sunday, BJP leaders say she will continue in her position and that she is in hospital

title: LDF alleges Thiruvananthapuram BJP councillor R. Sugathan’s signature was forged in council attendance register
content: According to the LDF, the act is intended to falsely show Sugathan’s presence at Corporation council meetings he actually missed while in hiding

title: Naidu to launch water schemes worth ₹30,156 crore in Kadapa on October 5
content: With 27.36 lakh new tap connections, the scheme aims to provide clean drinking water to 3.27 crore rural households

title: Thackeray cousins lead march to BMC against CEC, seek end to SIR in Maharashtra
content: The march added to the campaign that Opposition parties have run against the Election Commission over the SIR and the working of the panel

title: Focus is on strengthening export ecosystem in A.P., says APNRTS president
content: Andhra Pradesh Non-Resident Telugu Society president Vemuru Ravi Kumar said there is a need to improve the functioning of the State’s ports to make them more attractive to exporters and traders

title: Worker dies in explosion at factory in Kasaragod
content: High-pressure gas reportedly escaped from a boiler, throwing the worker into a poultry waste pit; two others were injured while attempting to rescue him

title: Navy sailor arrested for allegedly leaking classified information to Pakistani intelligence operative
content: Sailor met female Pakistani operative on social media a few months ago and shared sensitive information with her; police found suspicious digital activity, placed him under surveillance before arrest in Coimbatore on October 3

title: Man dies after off-road vehicle crashes into house in Kozhikode
content: The vehicle reportedly lost control while being reversed after dropping off a passenger at a house where a funeral was being held

title: Dentist dismissed after joining black flag protest against Minister in Keralam
content: Sidharth Ravindran  was working temporarily at the Kanhangad District Hospital under the National Health Mission.  He was dismissed after authorities concluded that his participation in the protest violated the terms of the agreement he had signed while joining the service

title: Sharmila reiterates demand for CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation
content: APCC president alleges unilateral decisions in Election Commission raise questions over transparency, accountability and collective decision-making

title: Pinarayi Vijayan seeks strigent action against YC workers, police over University Hostel violence
content: In a letter to the Home Minister, the CPI(M) veteran alleged that the decision by the Youth Congress to commence its march from the hostel premises instead of its usual protest venues was a deliberate attempt to provoke violence

title: Traders in Kozhikode announce protest against  unauthorised street vending
content: Traders owing allegiance to the KVVES demands that street vending be restricted to areas identified by local self-government institutions in accordance with the Street Vendors Act

title: CPI(M) appoints veteran leader  Chenthamarakshan as district secretary in Keralam’s Palakkad
content: The former legislator replaces E.N. Suresh Babu, who was removed from the post before completing his tenure following criticism of the district leadership over factionalism, rebel activity and electoral setbacks

title: C-DIT’s pact with Indian Institute of Creative Technologies to aid in establishment of AVGC-XR Centre of Excellence in Thiruvananthapuram
content: Also aims to strengthen Keralam’s animation, visual effects, gaming, comics and extended reality (AVGC-XR) ecosystem

title: Victory, not number of seats, is the key: Akhilesh amid SP-Congress seat-sharing spat
content: ‘Both the parties will win and form the government in an alliance. When have we talked about defeat? We too are talking about victory...Elections are fought on the basis of ideology. In terms of ideology, the Congress party is number one in the entire country,’ U.P. Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam says

title: Udayagiri pays tributes to son of the soil Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
content: The acclaimed filmmaker studied up to SSC in Althuri Rami Reddy Government High School in the town and later migrated to Chennai, where he made a promising career in the tinsel town

title: DYFI leader booked over alleged remarks against District Police Chief in Kozhikode
content: Case registered over remarks reportedly made during a DYFI march against alleged police excesses in Delhi

title: Wildlife Week: ITREK plants native saplings at Ponmudi
content: Thirty native tree saplings were planted near the existing shola forest close to the cafeteria at Ponmudi

title: Kerala HC directs CBI to investigate 14-year-old case of a missing paramilitary force soldier
content: Subash Chandra Bose, a native of Vengoor in Ernakulam serving with the Tripura State Rifles, went missing in April 2012 while travelling by train to rejoin duty after leave.

title: 31 tonnes of e-waste collected in Wayanad; district targets e-waste-free model status by November 1
content: Kalpetta and Sultan Bathery accounted for 12 tonnes each, while five tonnes were collected from Mananthavady and two tonnes from Panamaram

title: AP Chambers urges Centre to address issues of human hair industry
content: Calling for urgent policy intervention, it says the sector is under severe stress for the past seven to eight years due to the continued outflow of raw human hair without adequate regulatory safeguards

title: As first Agniveer batch complete term, services suggest improvements to scheme
content: Army, Navy, Air Force have submitted recommendations based on four years of experience in implementing the Agniveer scheme; armed forces seek to balance need for younger force with operational experience and continuity

title: Process disenfranchising millions, turning them to second class citizens is arbitrary, says Justice Bhuyan
content: The Supreme Court judge says no amount of whataboutery can justify the exclusion of voters en masse from the electoral rolls as such an action is fatal to the Constitution

title: Rabies deaths recorded in India far lesser than estimates from ICMR-led study
content: The Health Ministry’s Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme-Integrated Health Information Platform is a disease surveillance system, while the Registrar General of India’s Medical Certification of Cause of Death captures medically certified causes through civil registration — this absence of a complete national count underscores the gaps in India’s rabies mortality surveillance

title: 'Pulled out dagger’: 'Drunk' driver attacks BJP MLA in Assam; 2 home guards injured
content: A truck driver attacked BJP MLA Ritu Baran Sarmah outside his office in Guwahati and created chaos. The driver, believed to be intoxicated, rammed a parked vehicle belonging to party workers. Sarmah stated that the police initially handled the situation, but it escalated when the driver brandished a dagger. During the confrontation, two home guards sustained injuries while trying to intervene.

title: Asian Games: PT Usha names Kumkum Mohod, Sujeet Kalkal as Team India’s MVPs
content: At the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, Kumkum Mohod and Sujeet Kalkal shone brightly, capturing the spotlight with their remarkable achievements. Mohod clinched three medals, including two golds, breaking South Korea's stronghold in archery. Meanwhile, Kalkal staged an impressive comeback to win gold in men's 65kg freestyle wrestling. Indian Olympic Association president PT Usha lauded their tenacity, announcing plans to celebrate their triumphs in an upcoming ceremony.

title: Michael and Susan Dell backed $42M Hurricane Harvey recovery fund in 2017
content: Following the devastation of Hurricane Harvey, Michael and Susan Dell launched the Rebuild Texas Fund, which garnered more than $100 million aimed at helping affected areas. This significant initiative enabled the reconstruction of 3,740 homes and the reopening of 1,411 businesses. Additionally, it delivered health services to 265,842 residents while emphasizing community-led recovery efforts throughout the three-year timeline.

title: Sharad Sagar left US to work in India; years later, White House invited him back
content: After studying in the US, Sharad Vivek Sagar decided to return to Bihar, despite his friends' disbelief. They teased him, challenging his choice, and he quipped that only a White House invitation would lure him back. Years later, his dedication to education earned him an invite from Barack Obama, turning a light-hearted jest into reality and representing his commitment to his home state.

title: 'It’s about time': Jaffer backs left-haned batter as Kohli's replacement at No.3
content: Kohli has confirmed that the 2027 edition will be his last ODI World Cup for India, meaning the team will have to find a replacement at No. 3, a position he has held for many years.

title: ‘Beti Bachao Delhi Police Se!’: CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke on Neha Bora’s detention
content: Members of the All India Students’ Association (AISA) protested near Jantar Mantar, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. During the protest, AISA president Neha Bora was reportedly detained by the Delhi Police in a vehicle. Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) workers, including Saurabh Bhardwaj, were also detained while protesting at India Gate. Bhardwaj alleged mistreatment by officers during his detention, questioning the treatment of the common man.

title: From India to Australia: How 6 countries got caught up in flydubai terror
content: On September 30, the flydubai Flight FZ1073 faced a cockpit attack when Omani co-pilot Hammam al-Hammami stabbed Captain Smit Machchhar. The injured pilot bravely opened the cockpit door, allowing crew and passengers to subdue the co-pilot. The flight was diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where al-Hammami was apprehended by authorities. Investigations have since been undertaken by several countries into al-Hammami’s background and possible extremist ties.

title: Michigan collector paid $30 for painting; it later sold for record $1.35 million
content: At a recent estate sale, a man bought a Gertrude Abercrombie painting for only $30. Upon confirming its authenticity at an exhibition, he opted to auction the piece. Titled Alderman Merriam's Shells, the painting was anticipated to sell between $150,000 and $250,000. Remarkably, it sold for a staggering $1,060,000 at Freeman's auction, setting a new high for the artist and highlighting the incredible value of art investments.

title: Texas court blocks border barrier construction in Big Bend amid landowner challenge
content: In a significant ruling, a federal judge has temporarily halted the construction of border barriers in Texas' Big Bend area. Local landowners and environmental advocates express concerns about restricted access to the Rio Grande, claiming the barriers would disrupt the ecosystem and infringe on constitutional rights. The federal government asserts that security measures necessitate these barriers. This decision has sparked six lawsuits contesting the planned border initiatives.

title: Larry Ellison bought homes near his Florida mansion, quite purchase made residents upset
content: Larry Ellison has purchased eight residential properties in Palm Meadows Estates, Florida, for his household staff. These properties, costing nearly $10 million, are located conveniently near his main estate. Residents expressed concerns over the clustering of properties under a single corporate owner, prompting new ownership restrictions by the homeowners association. The homes will accommodate domestic employees and private educators for his children.

title: California crews uncover 40-million-year-old mammal bones 12 feet underground
content: In a remarkable find during construction in Oceanside, California, fossilized remains were unearthed at a considerable depth. Expert paleontologist Joseph El Adli confirmed the identification of the bones, prompting a meticulous excavation effort. These fossils, dating back 40 to 45 million years from the Eocene Epoch, are under investigation to discern if they belong to brontotheres or amynodonts.

title: Jio Platforms IPO likely by Oct-end; $3.8 bn issue, $143-146 bn company valuation: Report
content: Jio Platforms is preparing for its stock market debut with an estimated issue size of $3.8 billion, which could set records. The IPO aims for a valuation of $143-146 billion, with filings expected in mid-October. Reliance Jio’s expansion includes telecom, cloud, AI, and services, reporting significant financial growth recently. Past investors include tech giants like Meta and Google, contributing substantial capital to the company.

title: Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes face fresh twist in 1587 trademark lawsuit
content: Amid ongoing trademark issues, Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes are throwing their weight behind 1587 Prime, which has just garnered a spot on Yelp's list of Best New Restaurants for 2026. The dispute involves trademark claims from 1587 Sneakers, alleging infringement concerning their sneaker line. Seeking to distance the athletes from the legal matter, their lawyers are taking action while 1587 Prime thrives amid the conflict.

title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026: Full list of men's and women's ladder match participants
content: The 2026 WWE Money in the Bank is set to unfold in New Orleans, showcasing thrilling ladder matches for both men and women. Stars like Bron Breakker and CM Punk will battle it out in the Men's match, while the Women's match features talented competitors Sol Ruca and Roxanne Perez.

title: Yeh Rishta actor Mohsin Khan gets married to Tamanna
content: Mohsin Khan recently shared a delightful snapshot from his wedding festivities alongside Tamanna, creating quite a stir among fans. The photo, captioned 'The Day MashaAllah,' was met with excitement. Shortly after, videos of the couple enjoying a dance together emerged online. Following their engagement in August, Mohsin affectionately called her his 'Person,' prompting an outpouring of congratulations from admirers.

title: ‘Learn and keep moving forward’: Bindra’s message to Team India as LA 2028 beckons
content: After the Asian Games, Abhinav Bindra called for a revolution in high-performance systems for Indian athletes. While acknowledging India’s notable successes, he insisted on a careful assessment of both triumphs and failures. With the Los Angeles Olympics approaching, Bindra pointed out the necessity of stable athlete growth and targeted training.

title: Why are gold prices falling and will the decline continue?
content: International gold prices have fallen 26% from the record high of $5595 seen on January 29 this year. Indian gold prices peaked at the same time and are down around 23%. More recently, gold prices which rose to Rs 1,64,773/10 gm levels on MCX futures contract in the last week of August had fallen by more than 10% to a low Rs 1,45,991/10 gm levels last week.

title: Did Israel ignore warnings? UAE shared info about flydubai crew & Omani co-pilot
content: The UAE shared passenger and crew information with Israel before a FlyDubai flight whose Omani co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain and tried to seize control, AP reported. The co-pilot had reportedly been barred from flying by Oman over extremist concerns before joining FlyDubai. The incident has raised questions over Israel’s foreign-flight security system, despite previous warnings about inadequate checks and limited resources within the Transportation Ministry.

title: ‘I want him to reach that mark’: Gavaskar’s special wish for Rohit before retirement
content: Rohit scored 92 off 85 balls, with 10 fours and three sixes, in India’s third ODI against the West Indies. India lost the third ODI after the visitors successfully chased down 352, with captain Shai Hope scoring an unbeaten 162.

title: OCA cites 54 world records to declare Aichi-Nagoya Games a success despite chaos
content: The 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya wrapped up showcasing extraordinary athletic talent, with a staggering 54 world records shattered. While there were complaints about accommodations and transportation, the Olympic Council of Asia celebrated a nearly 20% revenue increase. With around 17,000 athletes taking part, the event demonstrated the power of sports to unite.

title: Trump announces 'Super Intelligence Force' to keep US ahead in AI race
content: US President Trump has launched a new Super Intelligence Force to streamline the government's artificial intelligence initiatives. This task force seeks to engage a diverse range of stakeholders, including consumers and tech giants. The announcement, following a pivotal meeting with influential technology leaders, emphasizes the importance of safely navigating AI's evolution.

title: Who is Sharmila Mona Sinha? The '3rd daughter' who became a US Hall of Famer
content: Sharmila Mona Sinha, who grew up in Kolkata, has been inducted into the National Women’s Hall of Fame. She became the second Indian woman to receive this honor, following Indra Nooyi. Sinha's journey has included time in investment banking and philanthropic efforts for women's rights. She currently serves as CEO of Equality Now, addressing issues affecting women globally.

title: Rs 2.47 cr cash deposit gets tax notice: Why ITAT Delhi ruled in favour of assessee
content: The shop owner said that deposited cash had come from sales generated by his pharmacy and had been properly recorded for in the concerned business books. To support his explanation, he submitted an audited balance sheet, VAT (value-added tax) returns and sample sales invoices. The Assessing Officer (AO), however, did not accept his account.

title: ‘Taken to unknown location’: AISA claims Neha Bora picked up by cops in unmarked car
content: During a demonstration in Delhi, police apprehended Neha Bora, the national president of AISA. The protest sought the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, but authorities had denied permission, leading to barricades that sparked tensions. As protesters attempted to break through, they insisted on being heard. This incident follows a series of protests where more than 150 demonstrators faced detention.

title: Crew of flydubai demanded release of co-pilot after he attacked Smit, claim flyers
content: In a shocking incident aboard a flydubai flight, the co-pilot viciously attacked the pilot with a crash axe, igniting a heroic response from passengers. Israeli individuals bravely intervened to subdue the assailant, while crew members' calls for the attackers' release sparked suspicion among those onboard. After landing in Tabuk, passengers faced psychological scars from the frightening ordeal, as investigations into the attack and crew actions continue.

title: Asiad '26: Leaner Indian contingent produces fewer golds but better return-per-medal
content: India's medal tally fell from 106 at the Hangzhou Asian Games to 85 at Aichi-Nagoya, but the contingent was also 25% smaller. The deeper comparison reveals a more nuanced picture: improved medals-per-athlete efficiency, an unchanged gold yield, and a striking dependence on the final two days.

title: ‘Doing everything to protect its ACP’: CJP claims Delhi Police refused to file FIR
content: The Cockroach Janata Party has accused Delhi Police of refusing to register a FIR against ACP Vivek Bhagat. This refusal was allegedly attributed to an ongoing Crime Branch investigation related to the complaint. Three women journalists also claimed manhandling by police during their detention at a protest. Delhi Police confirmed the complaints had been registered and that the matter was referred to the Crime Branch.

title: 'Same cheap rhetoric': Vijay slams Stalin, DMK over 'vile' remarks against women
content: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay condemned M K Stalin and the DMK for derogatory attacks on women. He spoke during a campaign rally in Dharapuram, highlighting the need for respectful discourse. Vijay asserted that his remarks were made as a son and brother of Tamil Nadu women. He warned of legal consequences for continued derogatory comments from DMK leaders.

title: Where will India be 5 to 10 years from now? EAM Jaishankar answers
content: During the Munich Leaders Meeting in New Delhi, S Jaishankar elaborated on India's potential to rise swiftly in the global power arena within the next decade. He pointed out the country's robust growth trajectory and advantageous demographic trends. Additionally, Jaishankar contrasted the significant influence held by the United States and China with that of current middle powers, recognizing the complexity of evolving global power dynamics.

title: Asian Games MVPs: Meet teenage sensation Yu Zidi & sprint king Puripol Boonson
content: Yu Zidi, a 13-year-old swimmer from China, set multiple records and won three gold medals at the Asian Games. Puripol Boonson, a 20-year-old sprinter from Thailand, achieved a 100m-200m double with four record-breaking performances. Both athletes earned the titles of Female and Male Most Valuable Players for their remarkable achievements. Their performances established them as promising stars in Asian sports moving forward.

title: 'Assault on her private parts, hit with cooker': Woman tortured over dowry in Saudi
content: Anju, a 24-year-old woman, has reported severe abuse by her husband Nandu and his family over dowry demands. After four months of marriage, she claims the harassment began shortly after the wedding. Anju described physical assaults involving household objects and severe psychological torment, including threats with a knife. She was brought back to Kerala after enduring this treatment and sought medical help.

title: From 89/3 to 111 all out: Mukesh, Akash trigger J&K collapse as RoI win Irani Cup
content: Mukesh returned figures of 6/33 to claim his 11th five-wicket haul in first-class cricket and dismantle the Jammu and Kashmir batting line-up. Akash, playing his comeback game, supported his Bengal teammate with 3/25 as J&K, chasing 279, were bowled out for 111.

title: Pakistan braces for showdown as Imran Khan’s party pushes ahead with march
content: Imran Khan, 73, has been in jail since 2023 after being convicted in a corruption case. He is currently held at the high-security Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi. PTI has also called for the release of Khan’s sisters and other people arrested ahead of the protest. It wants a proper medical examination of Khan’s wife, Bushra Bibi, and has demanded that their legal cases be heard without interference.

title: Mad Sandhu Murder Was Planned, Shooters Chased Him Before Attack: Cops
content: Mad Sandhu, one of the most well-known LGBTQ personalities of Punjab, was shot by two men on a bike on Saturday at a car-washing point on Loharka Road in Amritsar. He died while being taken to the hospital.

content: Iranian and US officials last week held indirect talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, with Tehran saying it presented seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
